settings.title: Settings
settings.output_pattern_tip: {name}: source file name / {ext}: extension / {date}: processing date (YYYYMMDD) / {time}: processing time (HHMMSS)
settings.mode_smart_cut: Re-encodes only around each cut point (up to the next keyframe) with the source's codec and bitrate, and copies the rest as is. Cuts are frame-accurate and the quality loss is minimal.
settings.mode_simple_copy: Copies everything without re-encoding. Fastest and lossless, but the start of each keep range moves to the next keyframe (with B-frames, the end also moves back to the previous keyframe). Nothing is re-encoded, so there are no encoding settings.
settings.mode_full_reencode: Re-encodes all keep ranges with the source's codec, scan type (interlaced etc.) and bitrate. This takes time.
settings.output_format_avs: Writes an AviSynth script (.avs) that reads only the keep ranges of the source recording, instead of a video, together with a timecode file (.timecode.txt) and the audio of the keep ranges (.flac). The script reads them with L-SMASH Works. The processing mode is not used.
settings.output_format_vpy: Writes a VapourSynth script (.vpy) that reads only the keep ranges of the source recording, instead of a video, together with a timecode file (.timecode.txt) and the audio of the keep ranges (.flac). The script reads them with L-SMASH Works. The processing mode is not used.

thresholds.no_db: The history DB is not available, so the thresholds cannot be shown.
thresholds.name_min_gap: Gap between boundaries in a long silence (s)
thresholds.name_logo_cm: Logo match for CM candidates (at most)
thresholds.tip_silence_db: Audio quieter than this counts as silence.
thresholds.tip_min_silence: Silences at least this long become boundary candidates.
thresholds.tip_long_silence: In silences at least this long, every scene change becomes a boundary candidate.
thresholds.tip_scene_min: A difference from the previous frame of at least this counts as a scene change (0-255).
thresholds.tip_min_gap: Boundary candidates inside a long silence are kept at least this far apart.
thresholds.tip_logo_program: A segment whose average logo match is at least this is treated as programme.
thresholds.tip_logo_cm: A segment whose average logo match is at most this is a CM candidate.
thresholds.tip_length_tolerance: A segment within this of a multiple of 5 s or 15 s has a CM-like length.
thresholds.tip_max_cm_seconds: The longest segment treated as a single CM.
thresholds.tip_long_tolerance: A long promo counts as a CM only within this of a multiple of 15 s.
thresholds.tip_long_cm_seconds: The longest promo treated as a CM where CMs continue.
thresholds.tip_short_seconds: Segments up to this long between the programme and CMs or the margins are short segments.
thresholds.tip_min_segment_seconds: Segments shorter than this are joined to the segment before them.
thresholds.tip_long_program_seconds: Segments longer than this are programme, not a single CM.
thresholds.tip_silent_fraction: A segment that is silent for at least this fraction is a silent segment.
thresholds.hint_global: The all-stations values are used for items a station has no value of its own for.
thresholds.hint_station: This station's values do not affect other stations. Items without a value of its own use the all-stations value.
thresholds.hint_few: Stations with fewer than {count} recordings are not tuned (they use the all-stations values).
thresholds.error_logo_order: "Logo match for CM candidates" is larger than "Logo match for programme".
thresholds.error_cm_order: "Longest long CM" is shorter than "Longest single CM".
thresholds.hint_auto: The values are tuned automatically from the recorded cuts after each batch. A result is used only when it scores better on recordings not used for tuning and its recall there drops by less than {points} points. New values are used from the next recording you open.
